afterImage.name: Contract Leasing Corporation
afterImage.description: Contract Leasing Corporation is a U.S. transportation-equipment platform that leases and manages trailers and intermodal chassis for private fleets, carriers, logistics providers, drayage operators and cold-chain users. CLC also provides equipment sales, maintenance, roadside assistance and fleet consulting through a network of branches and depots. The company reported approximately 18,000 units and 13 locations in January 2024. Funds advised by Wafra acquired CLC on August 2, 2022, and current Wafra and CLC disclosures continue to identify the investment and governance relationship. The exact Wafra fund, legal investment vehicle, ownership percentage and any current founder stake are not publicly disclosed.
